objectives.title: Improve cinematic edit quality end to end
acceptance: auditable director decisions
purposeful shot timing motion and transition intent
renderer consumes plan without black frames or timing regressions
npm run build passes
do not introduce arbitrary shot-count bottlenecks
exercise behaviour across small and large media sets
every new quality or continuity mechanism must affect the production decision path
after the first successful implementation perform an adversarial review and fix any regression or dead/unwired logic found
prefer a genuinely better edit over a larger or more sophisticated-looking diff
constraints: story structure must be dynamic rather than a fixed four-shot template

objectives.title: Strengthen the universal executable timeline
acceptance: timeline preserves source identity and editorial roles
timing trims transforms speed and transitions remain executable
duration budget is deterministic
npm run build passes
exercise short and rich timelines
verify new timing or continuity logic is actually consumed by the executable timeline
perform an adversarial second-pass review before declaring the objective complete
